A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Off-The-Grid research work. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and supplementary sections are readable, allowing retained, relocated, revised, and removed material to be matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original novel-view synthesis, geometry, and ablation results in Tables 1–3, plus focal-length experiments in supplementary Tables 4–5.

after.justification: v2 reports original novel-view synthesis, geometry, and ablation results in Tables 1–4, including experiments on additional datasets and new component controls.

M1.justification: The VGGT backbone, U-Net decoder, DSNT-based placement, adaptive densities, confidence pruning, and training losses are retained. The added entropy formula explains an existing calculation. Pixel-plus-offset and no-self-rendering variants are experimental controls, not changes to the proposed full model.

E1.justification: Training expands from six datasets to ten by adding WildRGBD, BlendedMVS, DTU, and KITTI360. Evaluation adds 7Scenes, SCRREAM, Tanks and Temples, and MipNeRF360 to DL3DV and Charge. SCRREAM also extends quantitative geometry evaluation, while the separate DL3DV focal-length evaluation disappears.

E2.justification: The main NVS comparison changes from AnySplat, FLARE, and VGGT+DepthSplat to AnySplat and DA3-GIANT-1.1. DA3 also joins the geometry comparison. Placement ablations add a SplatterImage-style pixel-plus-offset comparator and AnySplat. DepthSplat remains in the supplementary qualitative depth comparison.

E3.justification: v2 reports target-pose scale correction, which v1 explicitly omitted for its own model. DL3DV sampling changes from fixed frame spacing to uniform sequence sampling; image sizing changes from training-resolution inputs and 518×518 renders to maximum-dimension-518 resizing. Geometry reporting drops AUC@15, depth-threshold accuracy, focal-length MAE, and the angular-error threshold metric.

E4.justification: v2 Table 3 adds no-self-rendering and pixel-plus-offset controls, testing self-rendering and detection against alternative placement flexibility. Placement experiments now cover Tanks and Temples and MipNeRF360; the explicit two-resolution pixel-aligned comparison is removed. Existing adaptive-density/confidence results are retained in Table 4, and supplementary depth case studies remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, uncertainty intervals, or significance tests. Learned per-Gaussian confidence and averaging across view configurations do not constitute statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 contain substantially revised and additional results. For Charge, v1 reports worse AbsRel than VGGT at every tested view count; v2 Table 2 reports 0.1609 versus 0.178. Changed training and evaluation prevent interpreting this as a same-setting gain. Focal-length results are partly removed, while v2 Table 4 exactly retains the earlier adaptive-density/confidence scores.

T1.justification: The DSNT expectation equation and mathematical loss definitions are retained. Writing out standard Shannon entropy elaborates the existing patch-entropy criterion; no new theorem, proof, formal assumption, or substantive derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: v1 presents improved camera-pose estimation as a headline contribution and emphasizes implications for annotation-free training of 3D foundation models. v2 removes that headline contribution and narrows the conclusion to marginal improvement of VGGT geometry. The central placement, compactness, and novel-view synthesis claims remain.

C2.justification: v2 adds limitations concerning view-dependent color, lighting variations, human subjects, and very thin geometry. It attributes DA3 rendering defects to transparency and focal-length inaccuracies and discusses compatibility with view-aggregation compression. The existing missing-surface limitation and supplementary depth-failure explanations largely remain.

D1.justification: v2 specifies grayscale histograms for entropy calculation and identifies the DA3 checkpoint version and parameter count. The median-depth rendering qualifier is omitted without a stated replacement procedure. Supplementary architecture details, softmax temperature, interpolation instructions, hardware disclosure, and project-page destination remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Targeted citations add the new datasets, DA3, ICO3D, Chroma, and Zpressor. Previously cited SplatterImage becomes an explicit alternative placement design. The related-work organization and central positioning against rigid primitive grids remain largely unchanged; the Charge publication update is bibliographic.

P1.justification: v2 edits the abstract, introduction, and conclusion and reorganizes the experimental discussion: geometry evaluation moves inside the comparison subsection, and ablations separate placement from density/confidence. The focal-length appendix section is removed. Overall section progression and most method, related-work, and implementation prose remain recognizable.

P2.justification: Figure 1 becomes full-width. The main comparison and ablation image grids are replaced and expanded, while v1 Figure 7 moves to v2 Figure 6. Tables are substantially redesigned around dataset averages and separate ablation questions; the focal-length appendix tables disappear. The core architecture diagrams and supplementary Figure 9 are retained.

improvement.justification: The new learned-offset and no-self-rendering controls address important gaps in isolating the proposed placement mechanism and training design. Broader held-out evaluation and the DA3 comparison strengthen evidence for generality and competitiveness, while narrower geometry claims and concrete limitations improve calibration. Losing per-view and focal-length breakdowns and making tables much denser reduces reporting clarity, but the added experimental controls provide a substantial net improvement.
